gaps.sentence: The fire is believed ___ by faulty wiring.
gaps.explanation: 'believed to have been + participle' — the cause was earlier.

gaps.sentence: Her success was largely ___ to her coach.
gaps.explanation: 'be down to somebody/something' = be caused by.

gaps.sentence: We had the walls ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'have something done' = arrange for it to be done: had the walls painted.

gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.

gaps.sentence: She was made ___ for three hours at the airport.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'be made' takes to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: No matter how hard he pulled, he ___ open the drawer.
The company has ___ several new jobs in the area.

gaps.explanation: Past perfect for the earlier of two past moments.
